{{Quote|We've got the machine! We've got the muscle! And soon, the Ewoks will be just a furry little memory.|[[Umwak]]|<ref name="WW">{{Ewoks|Wicket's Wagon}}.</ref>}}
The '''Second Battle of the Soul Trees''' was a confrontation in the [[Ewok–Dulok wars/Legends|Ewok–Dulok wars]] between the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] and the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] of the [[Dulok Swamp]]. The battle occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], after [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], grandson of [[Erpham Warrick]], reconstructed his ancestor's [[Ewok battle wagon|battle wagon]], which had been used to defeat the Duloks in the much earlier [[First battle of the Soul Trees|First Battle of the Soul Trees]]. Nevertheless, the Ewoks lost the war machine to King [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh's]] [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]]. Under guidance of their oracle, [[Murgoob]], the Duloks aimed the contraption at the Ewoks' [[Soul Tree]]s. Warrick and another Ewok named [[Malani]] managed to sabotage the battle wagon before it could reach its target and cause any real damage.<ref name="WW" />
